invariants: WAIT is represented by QUEUED plus queue_reason, never another durable queue.
Admission snapshot is immutable; source_snapshot is assigned once after lease-protected validation.
A QUEUED row holds no active_workspace_id, persistent owner token, or long-lived OS lease.
Deadlines are absolute UTC and are not extended by restart, backup, or lease retry.
Task policy and Cron misfire are evaluated independently from Workspace resource waiting.
SOURCE_SUPERSEDED produces SKIPPED with zero script attempts and no automatic latest-source retry.
Unknown source ownership or incomplete cleanup requires RECOVERY_REQUIRED, never READY by empty-root reconstruction.
Terminal execution clears active_workspace_id but preserves workspace_id and source history.
All execution, editor, Git, Config, Node, recovery, and backup consumers use the same Workspace identity and lock inode.
No production behavior has been dynamically qualified by this design artifact.
